data.title: Confirmation of electricity supply contract "Rhein Strom fix 24"
data.summary: Exempelenergie Rheinschiene AG confirms the electricity contract "Rhein Strom fix 24" that Esra Exempelrhein signed at the door on 20 November 2026, with a monthly advance payment of €74.00 and supply expected to start on 1 February 2027.
data.explanation: This letter confirms a new electricity contract you signed during a doorstep sales visit. Because it was agreed at the door, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal (Widerruf) from the date of signing, without giving reasons. You can still decide whether to keep this contract or withdraw from it — the app shows the deadline for sending your withdrawal. If you do nothing, the contract continues and supply starts around 1 February 2027 with a monthly advance payment of €74.00. Compare this offer with your current provider's price before deciding, since doorstep energy contracts are sometimes more expensive than standard offers.
